annotations.title: Keep my MCP server / paid API findable and payable

description: For sellers: 30 days of official MCP Registry publishing on every new version, a daily listing watch (registry, Glama, x402 Bazaar, npm, PyPI, health) and daily payment checks of up to 10 x402 endpoints, with one signed webhook. $12 per 30 days; renew with plan_id.

api_host.description: Host of your paid x402 API, e.g. api.example.com (we use the endpoints the x402 Bazaar lists for it).

endpoints.description: Or name up to 10 paid endpoints yourself.

plan_id.description: To renew: an existing plan_id (adds 30 days to everything).

publish.description: Publish to the official MCP Registry (default true).

url.description: Your MCP server's public https:// endpoint (listing watch + registry publishing).

webhook.description: Public https:// URL for signed listing.changed, payment.changed and plan.expiring events.
